queries.definitions: wrangler d1 execute 8978-ai-authority-dev --remote --config deployment/wrangler.authority-migrations.jsonc --command "SELECT type, name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','index') AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY type, name" --json
queries.appliedMigrations: wrangler d1 execute 8978-ai-authority-dev --remote --config deployment/wrangler.authority-migrations.jsonc --command "SELECT name FROM d1_migrations ORDER BY id" --json
queries.authorityRows: wrangler d1 execute 8978-ai-authority-dev --remote --config deployment/wrangler.authority-migrations.jsonc --command "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM authority_resources) + (SELECT count(*) FROM authority_limits) + (SELECT count(*) FROM authority_identity_keys) + (SELECT count(*) FROM authority_test_evidence) + (SELECT count(*) FROM authority_rollbacks) + (SELECT count(*) FROM authority_project_knowledge) + (SELECT count(*) FROM authority_owner_keys) + (SELECT count(*) FROM authority_standing_state) + (SELECT count(*) FROM authority_development_activation_evidence_bundles) + (SELECT count(*) FROM authority_development_activation_evidence_writes) AS authority_row_count" --json

stopConditions: the exact owner authorization, account identity, or completed migration execution record is unavailable
the database identity, WNAM region, null jurisdiction, or production version differs
any query cannot be proven read-only before execution
the table, index, or applied-migration inventory differs from the expected ordered inventory
any authority table contains a row
the evidence-write foreign key differs from the reviewed migration
the integrity check does not return exactly ok
definition-level verification is unavailable or ambiguous
the requested operation would mutate SQL, bind, deploy, write evidence, activate, retry, restore, clean up, or delete
